what_to_detect: A spell candidate whose card has convoke is affordable (affordable true): its total cost, after any cost changes, is payable with mana and untapped creatures of the right colours its controller controls.
near_miss: A spell candidate whose card has convoke is not affordable: the untapped creatures and mana available cannot cover its total cost.
record_fields: the candidate's source card keyword line (sidecar, or gen-3 card lines kind keyword)
